title: A towel twice as thick
hook: Same size, twice as thick, twice the water. Does it get more face to dry from?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that doubling a towel's thickness doubles the water it holds but not the face area the water leaves through, so it dries slower

misconception: A thick towel dries about as fast as a thin one of the same size.
objective: Twice as thick at the same width and length means twice the cloth, but the open face is still the same two sides. So each cm³ of cloth gets half as much open face.
